body:
Best and Worst Experience Of My Life
So me and my friend (B) smoked a lot of weed throughout the past year or so, and wanted to step up our game. We decided to try MDMA for the first time in my garage. We had no clue what it was gonna do, how to handle it, and when to re-dose, we basically went in all guns blazing. (Before we took the MDMA, we had also had a few edibles
Before we took the MDMA, we had also had a few edibles
each which werent very strong).
So at 9, we took one dab worth of pure MDMA, we waited 40 minutes and felt nothing. We then decided to finish off our little pouch, in total, two dabs worth each. We then waited another half an hour and nothing happened so we went and had a joint. Half way through this, I dont know if it jump started our rolling, but Ive never felt like what we felt like after one joint. We were incredibly hyper, dancing lots and messing around loads. By about 10:20, the first dose of MDMA kicked in. We danced until 10:45 non-stop, full on raving like a music festival, B was drinking water however I wasnt thirsty so stupidly I drunk nothing. By about 10:50 I started to freak out, I sat down and was like I dont like this, I feel like Im going to die
This lasted about 15 minutes, until it fully kicked in. I started hyperventilating, and my vision was going. I begged B to go and get my parents but, thankfully, she didnt. I then tried to get up myself to go get them, I collapsed on the floor and was slurring my words. At this point, it felt like something out a movie. About one minute later, I started throwing up, Ive never thrown up so much in my life. I remember thinking about what everyones life was going to be like without me, absolutely convinced I was going die. 5 minutes later, I was falling in and out of consciousness, weak, unable to keep myself awake/alive. I told B that I loved her and I flopped forwards, I slowly began to let go, and I felt myself being pulled out of my body, like  my soul was leaving.
I felt myself being pulled out of my body, like  my soul was leaving.
One thing I clearly remember before everything went black, was a huge feeling of guilt and regret. If I was to die, I would ruin everyones lives. And I would have to restart life. At about 11:10PM, I died for about 1 second. I remember the music in the background was gone, I couldnt feel anything. I felt a sudden push, and I sat up super, super quick and rubbed my face.
About 10 minutes after literally dying, I had a huge epiphany. I began to realise that I wasnt real, that I was a collection of emotions, thoughts, and memories. I sat down against a wall and had a huge wave of love hit me, that (I imagine) is what MDMA is supposed to feel like. I was grateful for everything, the world was amazing because I was alive. After cleaning up the utter mess I had created on my mums carpet, I stayed up till 2AM thinking about the true meaning of life, whereas B fell asleep at about 1AM.
When I woke up in the morning, I had 4 hours sleep. I was still stoned because we smoked a hell of a lot that night. I spent the whole next day feeling fuzzy and strange, but not depressed. That night was both the best and worst experience of my life.
